To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we demonstrate that mode-localization and the associated curve veering effect in a pair of weak coupling DETF resonators is a highly efficient and sensitive mechanism for charge sensing.
the phenomenon of mode-localization in weakly coupled mechanical resonators is capable of enhancing the sensitivity of a resonant electromechanical sensor by nearly three orders of the magnitude.

a micromechanical device consisting of a pair of nearly identical coupled, single crystal silicon, DETF resonators can be used for ultrasensitive charge monitoring with the shifts in the eigenmodes of the device being nearly three orders of magnitudes higher than the corresponding shifts in the resonance frequencies of the same device for identical input charge.
